name: ADB-FUBIATA
summary: ADB-FUBIATA (AD-18, FUB-ACADB, ADB-FUBIACA) is a synthetic cannabinoid compound first identified in 2021. It is closely related in structure to the older compound ADB-FUBICA but with the amide linker group extended by the addition of a methylene bridge.

pharmacology.text: ADB-FUBIATA has many times lower affinity for cannabinoid receptors than ADB-FUBICA with an EC50 of only 635 nM at CB1, but retains full agonist activity at this target, while being practically inactive at CB2. ADB-FUBIATA is a tryptamine derivative, but is completely inactive as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.

uses.text: It started to be sold as an ingredient in grey-market synthetic cannabis blends following the introduction of legislation in China which for the first time introduced general controls on various classes of synthetic cannabinoids, but did not encompass compounds where the linker group had been extended in this fashion.

summaryZh: ADB-FUBIATA是一種含氮有機氟化合物，分子式C23H26FN3O2，能作為大麻素受體的激動劑，其對CB1的EC50僅為635 nM，對CB2幾乎無活性。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: It appeared in 2021 after China introduced blanket controls on whole classes of synthetic cannabinoids, and its extra methylene bridge makes it far weaker at the CB1 receptor than its parent.
fact.zh: 它在2021年出現，當時中國剛對整類合成大麻素實施全面管制。它多出的一個亞甲基橋，使它在CB1受體上的效力遠弱於母體化合物。
fact.zhHans: 它在2021年出现，当时中国刚对整类合成大麻素实施全面管制。它多出的一个亚甲基桥，使它在CB1受体上的效力远弱于母体化合物。
